instruction: Solve steady-state heat conduction in a 100x50x10 mm Copper block with DC3D8 mesh and 100/20 C end-face temperatures.
init: none; config uploads no files and launches Abaqus/CAE 2025LE
failure_reason: The current GT passes step, Copper conductivity, section, 100x50x10 geometry, DC3D8 mesh, and set checks, then fails the first 100 C temperature BC signature. Abaqus/CAE 2025LE inspection confirms BC-COLD and BC-HOT are both valid TemperatureBC objects, but reopened objects expose neither createStepName nor magnitude as direct attributes, exactly the fields eval requires.

real_software_generation.method: Opened the exact staged Job-Thermal.cae in the GUI and ran a task-specific read-only inspection of both thermal BC objects; no replacement was written because all preceding current-eval checks passed and the blocker is evaluator API access.

cleanup: Closed Abaqus; removed staged Job-Thermal/eval outputs and Task 06 inspection files; verified Desktop and task-specific Documents files empty.
